import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a pairplot
pairplot = sns.pairplot(data, hue='species', markers=["o", "s", "D"],
                        plot_kws={'alpha': 0.7}, diag_kind='hist')

# Set the title for the pairplot
pairplot.fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset Pairplot', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
